_source: References/Templates.json inside build/EQD-Taskmaster-smoke.msapp (a real Power Apps Studio export). First-party ground truth for enum values that MS Learn documents but never enumerates.

_containerNotes.confirmed_from: two photos of Studio code view, 2026-08-04 (horizontal, then vertical+scroll)
container_properties: X / Y / Width / Height  — on the container itself only
child_properties: FillPortions   = <number>. How much of the SPARE space along the parent's Direction this child claims, as a share of what all children claim. 0 = none, i.e. the formula-bar equivalent of turning "Flexible width/height" OFF.
LayoutMinWidth  = <number>. Minimum size along the parent's Direction.
AlignInContainer = per-child override of the parent LayoutAlignItems (Set by container | Start | End | Center | Stretch) — display name confirmed, pa-yaml token NOT confirmed
_containerNotes.why_it_matters: Children of an AutoLayout container carry NO X/Y — the container places them. X/Y/Width/Height are exactly what Studio freezes to constants on paste, so container-laid-out content is the only layout that survives this gap intact.
_containerNotes.flexible_sizing_default: A child of an auto-layout container has "Flexible width" (or height, along the parent's Direction) turned ON BY DEFAULT — MS Learn walks you through switching it off in "Building responsive canvas apps". While it is on, an explicit Width/Height on that child is ADVISORY: the container distributes space by FillPortions instead. This is why setting a child to a fixed width appears to do nothing. Set FillPortions: =0 to pin it, and LayoutMinWidth as a floor. Cost this repo four iterations of cmpNestedSelect, 2026-08-05.
_containerNotes.fillportions_provenance: Documented on the Horizontal container control page as "Fill portions": "Defines how the individual component grows when there is more screen real-estate assigned to its parent... if child A has Fill portions 1 and child B has 2, A gets 1/3 of the extra space." Doc-grounded 2026-08-05, not yet seen in a Studio export.

_modernControls.confirmed_from: user-supplied Studio YAML + MS Learn output properties, 2026-08-04

ModernTextInput@1.0.0.output: Text  — SAME as classic, so no formula that reads an input had to change
ModernTextInput@1.0.0.props: Placeholder, Type (TextInputType.SingleLine|Multiline|Password|Search), TriggerOutput (TriggerOutput.Keypress|FocusOut|Delayed), MaxLength, Required, Default, Appearance, Align, AccessibleLabel

ModernNumberInput@1.0.0.output: Value  — a real number, not text
ModernNumberInput@1.0.0.props: Default, Min, Max, Step, Precision (DecimalPrecision.'0'|'1'|'2'), HintText, Align, Appearance, AccessibleLabel. NOTE: TriggerOutput was REMOVED from this control

ModernDatePicker@1.0.0.props: Placeholder, DefaultDate, StartDate, EndDate, StartOfWeek, Format (DatePickerFormat.LongAbbreviated|Short|Long or a custom string), IsEditable, DateTimeZone

ModernTabList@1.0.0.props: Items (array literal), Default (must match an item), Appearance (TabListAppearance.Underline|Filled|Subtle), Alignment (TabListAlignment.Start|Center), Size, FontWeight, AccessibleLabel

ModernButton@1.0.0.props: Text, OnSelect, Appearance (ButtonAppearance.Primary|Outline|Subtle), Icon (a STRING Fluent icon name, e.g. "Checkmark" — not the classic Icon enum), IconStyle, Layout (ButtonLayout.IconBefore), Tooltip, AccessibleLabel

_modernControls.kept_classic_deliberately: Classic/Button for the ~30 transparent full-template gallery hit targets — they depend on Fill: =RGBA(0,0,0,0) and BorderThickness: =0, which a Fluent button does not expose. Classic/Icon throughout, for the same reason plus the 180-value Icon enum.

Classic/ComboBox@2.4.0.output: Selected / SelectedItems  — as the modern one
Classic/ComboBox@2.4.0.seed: DefaultSelectedItems  — CONFIRMED on this control (=Parent.Default inside a data card)
Classic/ComboBox@2.4.0.props: Items, SelectMultiple, DefaultSelectedItems, SelectionColor, SelectionFill, Chevron{Fill,Background,HoverFill,HoverBackground,DisabledFill,DisabledBackground}, DisplayMode, Tooltip, plus the usual colour/border set
Classic/ComboBox@2.4.0.note: Distinct control from ModernCombobox@1.0.0. Studio generates this one inside classic data cards; the modern one is what you insert by hand today.
Classic/ComboBox@2.4.0.display_column: DisplayFields: =["Value"] and SearchFields: =["Value"] — STRING ARRAYS, not ItemDisplayText. Confirmed from a Studio export 2026-08-05. This is the classic family's way; the modern combo box uses ItemDisplayText: =ThisItem.<col> and the two are not interchangeable.
Classic/ComboBox@2.4.0.export_confirmed: Full code-view export 2026-08-05 over a Distinct() Items formula. Also confirms LayoutMinWidth / LayoutMinHeight are emitted on a control inside an auto-layout container. FillPortions did NOT appear — Studio emits only non-defaults, so that is consistent with it being at default rather than with it being invalid.

Classic/DropDown@2.3.1.output: Selected — a record. SelectedText is DEPRECATED; read .Selected.<Column>
Classic/DropDown@2.3.1.display_column: Items.Value  — a DOTTED property name; the column of Items to show
Classic/DropDown@2.3.1.props: Items, Items.Value, Default, AllowEmptySelection, Chevron{Fill,Background,HoverFill,HoverBackground,DisabledFill,DisabledBackground}, Selection{Color,Fill}, Padding*, plus the usual colour/border set
Classic/DropDown@2.3.1.note: Capital D in DropDown. Single-select only — use a ListBox or ComboBox for multiple.

ListBox@2.2.0.display_column: Items.Value  — same dotted form as the dropdown
ListBox@2.2.0.props: Items, Items.Value, Default, SelectMultiple, Selection{Color,Fill}, DisabledSelection{Color,Fill}, Padding*, plus the usual colour/border set
ListBox@2.2.0.note: NO Classic/ prefix — it is plain `ListBox@2.2.0`, the same trap as `Timer`. Only ONE item can be pre-selected via Default; for multiple defaults use a combo box.

ModernDropdown@1.0.0.output: Selected — a record; .Selected.Value for a string array
ModernDropdown@1.0.0.props: Items, ItemDisplayText, Default (a VALUE, not a table), Appearance, AccessibleLabel, ValidationState, OnChange
ModernDropdown@1.0.0.note: Grounded from MS Learn's own YAML sample rather than a Studio export. Single-select; the combo box is the multi-select / searchable one. Note Default here takes a value, where ModernCombobox takes DefaultSelectedItems, a TABLE.

Classic/Toggle@2.1.0.props: Default (boolean), Value, TrueText/FalseText, ShowLabel, TextPosition, TrueFill/TrueHoverFill, FalseFill/FalseHoverFill, HandleFill, RailFill, OnCheck, OnUncheck, OnChange, plus the usual colour/border set
Classic/Toggle@2.1.0.studio_defaults: BorderColor RGBA(0,0,0,0) · BorderStyle.None · Color RGBA(50,49,48,1) · DisabledBorderColor RGBA(0,0,0,0) · FalseFill RGBA(96,94,92,1) · FalseHoverFill RGBA(50,49,48,1) · FocusedBorderThickness 4 · Font.'Segoe UI' · HoverBorderColor RGBA(0,0,0,0) · PressedBorderColor RGBA(0,0,0,0) · TrueFill RGBA(0,120,212,1) · TrueHoverFill RGBA(16,110,190,1)
Classic/Toggle@2.1.0.note: PREFIXED — `Classic/Toggle@2.1.0` — because a modern Toggle shares the name. OnCheck/OnUncheck fire on the transition; OnChange fires on both. A toggle is a two-state control only — for a tri-state (yes/no/unset) SharePoint Boolean, use a dropdown or you cannot express Blank().

RichTextEditor@2.7.0.output: HtmlText — an HTML STRING, not plain text
RichTextEditor@2.7.0.props: Default (HTML in), HtmlText (out), EnableSpellCheck, DisplayMode, BorderColor, plus size/position
RichTextEditor@2.7.0.note: NO Classic/ prefix. The IN property is Default and the OUT property is HtmlText — they are NOT the same name, unlike a text input. What it emits is markup, so a SharePoint Multiple lines of text column receiving it must be Enhanced rich text; a plain-text column will store the tags literally. Read it back into an HtmlViewer@2.1.0, never into a Label.

Rating@2.1.0.props: Default, Max, ReadOnly, RatingFill, ShowValue, BorderThickness, FocusedBorderThickness, plus the usual colour/border set
Rating@2.1.0.studio_defaults: BorderColor RGBA(0,0,0,0) · BorderStyle.None · BorderThickness 2 · FocusedBorderThickness 4 · RatingFill RGBA(16,110,190,1)
Rating@2.1.0.note: NO Classic/ prefix. The modern Rating control adds Step (half stars); the classic one is whole stars only. Max defaults to 5 — set it explicitly if the column's scale is anything else.

Classic/Slider@2.1.0.props: Default (initial value), Min (default 0), Max (default 100), Layout (Layout.Horizontal|Vertical), HandleSize, ShowValue, ReadOnly, Reset, OnChange, RailFill/RailHoverFill, ValueFill/ValueHoverFill, HandleFill/HandleActiveFill/HandleHoverFill, plus the usual colour/border set
Classic/Slider@2.1.0.studio_defaults: BorderColor RGBA(0,0,0,0) · BorderStyle.None · BorderThickness 2 · DisabledBorderColor RGBA(0,0,0,0) · FocusedBorderThickness 4 · HandleActiveFill RGBA(255,255,255,1) · HandleHoverFill RGBA(255,255,255,1) · HoverBorderColor RGBA(0,0,0,0) · PressedBorderColor RGBA(0,0,0,0) · RailFill RGBA(184,187,184,1) · RailHoverFill RGBA(222,236,249,1) · ValueFill RGBA(96,94,92,1) · ValueHoverFill RGBA(0,120,212,1)
Classic/Slider@2.1.0.note: PREFIXED. RailFill is the track to the RIGHT of the handle, ValueFill the filled part to the LEFT — swap them and the slider reads backwards. A slider cannot express Blank(): it always has a number, so it cannot represent an unset optional column. Min/Max are inclusive; set them explicitly, because the 0–100 default silently clamps any real-world scale.

ModernSlider@1.0.0.output: Value — a number, READ-ONLY on this control
ModernSlider@1.0.0.props: Default (the input — NOT Value), Min, Max, LayoutDirection (LayoutDirection.Horizontal|Vertical), Size (SliderSize.Small|Medium|Large), BasePaletteColor, AccessibleLabel, Tooltip, OnChange
ModernSlider@1.0.0.note: Grounded from MS Learn's own YAML sample, not a Studio export — same provenance as ModernDropdown@1.0.0. VERSION TRAP: this control was revised. The OLD shape set `Value:` as the INPUT and `Layout: ="Horizontal"` as a STRING; the current shape splits them — `Default` in, `Value` read-only out — and takes typed enums (`LayoutDirection.Horizontal`, `SliderSize.Medium`). Any sample found online that assigns `Value:` is pre-revision and will not behave as written.

Classic/Radio@2.3.0.output: Selected — a record; .Selected.Value is the option text. SelectedText is DEPRECATED
Classic/Radio@2.3.0.display_column: Items.Value  — the same dotted form as DropDown and ListBox
Classic/Radio@2.3.0.props: Items, Items.Value, Default, Layout (Layout.Vertical|Horizontal), RadioSize, RadioBackgroundFill, RadioBorderColor, RadioSelectionFill, LineHeight, Padding*, Font, Size, Color/HoverColor/PressedColor/DisabledColor, plus the usual colour/border set
Classic/Radio@2.3.0.studio_defaults: BorderColor RGBA(50,49,48,1) · BorderStyle.None · BorderThickness 2 · Color RGBA(50,49,48,1) · DisabledBorderColor RGBA(0,0,0,0) · DisabledColor RGBA(161,159,157,1) · FocusedBorderThickness 4 · Font.'Segoe UI' · HoverColor RGBA(50,49,48,1) · HoverFill RGBA(0,0,0,0) · Items.Value =Value · PaddingTop/Bottom 5 · PressedColor RGBA(50,49,48,1) · PressedFill RGBA(0,0,0,0) · RadioBorderColor RGBA(50,49,48,1) · RadioSelectionFill RGBA(0,120,212,1)
Classic/Radio@2.3.0.note: PREFIXED. THIRD control to use the dotted `Items.Value:` display-column key, after DropDown and ListBox — that is now the classic-family convention, not a quirk. Single-select and always-visible, so it costs vertical space per option: right for 2–7 options, wrong beyond that (use a combo box). MS's guidance for the modern one is the same. LineHeight sets the gap between options.

_modernRadio_TOKEN_UNKNOWN.status: Semantics grounded on MS Learn; the pa-yaml TOKEN is NOT grounded — do not author it. The docs page is 'Radio modern control' (modern-controls-radio-group) and never names the token.
_modernRadio_TOKEN_UNKNOWN.semantics: Items, ItemDisplayText, Default, Selected (out), Layout (Layout.Vertical|Horizontal), Required, TriggerOutput, RadioSize, RadioBackgroundFill/BorderColor/SelectionFill, BasePaletteColor
_modernRadio_TOKEN_UNKNOWN.enum_trap: The modern Radio's orientation enum is `Layout.Vertical`, but the modern Slider's is `LayoutDirection.Horizontal` and a GroupContainer's is `LayoutDirection.Vertical`. Same concept, two enum names, no rule — check per control.

ModernCombobox@1.1.1.output: Selected  — a record; .Selected.Value for a string array
ModernCombobox@1.1.1.props: Items (array literal), ItemDisplayText, InputTextPlaceholder, SelectMultiple, IsSearchable, MultiValueDelimiter, Required, ValidationState
ModernCombobox@1.1.1.seed: DefaultSelectedItems — CONFIRMED on this control's own MS Learn page: 'the initial items selected… Must be a TABLE OF RECORDS from the Items data source.' With Items as an array literal, =[gVar] is the matching shape. No longer inferred.
ModernCombobox@1.1.1.note_1_1_1: CURRENT VERSION IS 1.1.1 (user-confirmed 2026-08-05) and it is NOT property-compatible with 1.0.0: TriggerOutput -> DelayOutput, Fields -> ItemDisplayText, SelectMultiple now defaults to TRUE, Appearance/ValidationState take typed enums. There is NO Reset PROPERTY on this control — classic ListBox has one, this does not, and authoring it fails the paste. The Reset() function still works on it.

_controlPrefixRule.rule: `Classic/` appears on exactly those control names that a modern Fluent control also uses, and is absent where no modern namesake exists.
_controlPrefixRule.status: PREDICTIVE ONLY — derived from every token grounded so far, and re-tested against Slider and Radio on 2026-08-05 (both prefixed, both with modern namesakes). Use it to guess which form to ask for; never to author an ungrounded token. Casing is still per-token (`DropDown` has a capital D, `ComboBox` a capital B).

_formNotes.confirmed_from: two photos of Studio code view, 2026-08-04 (Edit form over asset_library)
_formNotes.form: Form@2.4.4 · Variant: Classic · Layout: Vertical · Properties.DataSource
card_properties: DataField: ="Title"            — a STRING, the column's internal name
Default: =ThisItem.<column>     — the card's value in from the form's Item
Update: =DataCardValue1.Text    — the card's value OUT to SubmitForm
card_children_contract: MetadataKey: FieldName     — the caption label, Text: =Parent.DisplayName
MetadataKey: FieldValue    — the input, Default: =Parent.Default, MaxLength: =Parent.MaxLength,
_formNotes.schema_keys_confirmed_in_the_wild: Layout:, MetadataKey:, IsLocked: — all accepted by pa.schema.v3.0
_formNotes.note: DataSourceInfo's column argument is a SINGLE-QUOTED IDENTIFIER ('Title'), not a double-quoted string — consistent with the 3.24042 identifier change.

_powerFxNotes.Choices column argument: Studio writes it as a SINGLE-QUOTED identifier — Choices([@asset_library].'asset_owner'). Quotes are only required when the identifier needs escaping, so this repo's unquoted snake_case form is equally valid; the quoted form is Studio being defensive.
_powerFxNotes.Self: PaddingLeft: =If(Self.DisplayMode = DisplayMode.Edit, 5, 0) — Self is available in a control's own property formulas.
_powerFxNotes.Dotted property names: A property key can be qualified with a dot: `Items.Value: =Value` on a classic DropDown or ListBox names the column of Items to display. Valid pa-yaml, and easy to mistake for a typo.
